issue.title: Get a vector of systems

comments.body:
You should be able to get all system like described here:
https://sdk.dronecode.org/en/guide/connections.html#iterating-all-systems

However, for now you need to make sure yourself that all vehicles have different system IDs.
@mzahana is it not possible to use the UUIDs?

If something is automated in software UUID is more "convenient" because you it's unique.

I suggest you implement the method to get all system IDs yourself since you're already changed the API to work with system IDs instead of UUIDs.

@julianoes Would exposing [get_system_id](https://github.com/Dronecode/DronecodeSDK/blob/develop/core/system_impl.cpp#L518) in [system.cpp](https://github.com/Dronecode/DronecodeSDK/blob/develop/core/system.cpp) do any harm?

> @julianoes Would exposing get_system_id in system.cpp do any harm?

I guess it doesn't :smile:, so we might as well add it.
